slides.footer: PROPOSED: preferences + policy inference + information-seeking audits
slides.notes: Interfaces are implemented. Coupled objective, blanket properties and policy loop remain proposed.

slides.title: Predictive coding supplies acquisition credit
slides.status: Mechanism and acquisition comparisons measured; reader-training replication continues

panels.title: Same teaching problem
lines: Writes w held fixed in settling

slides.footer: SD-24: penalize e before adding w; old write-site prior penalized e + w.
slides.notes: 9 forward + 9 reverse evaluations per 8-step inference; JAX autodiff. Compare efficacy, harm, cost.

slides.title: A correction testbed with distinct controls
slides.status: Three realizations × five dependent orders; endpoint depends on dataset
slides.footer: zsRE / CounterFact: 1,000 edits. MQuAKE: descriptive at 300. This reader study uses BP, not PC credit.
slides.notes: 50 locality prompts do not exhaust specificity. Five orders within a realization are dependent.

slides.title: Retention improves, with limits to specificity
slides.status: Completed triplet + 270-cell comparator snapshot; preliminary three-realization analysis
slides.footer: Mean paraphrase retention: zsRE .9603; CounterFact .6780; MQuAKE .7156 (300 edits).
slides.notes: CounterFact vs stable: inconclusive. zsRE near-miss passes: 86 / 92 / 87 out of 100.

slides.title: How often, and how severe?
slides.status: HT-17: Stage-4 primary conditions; 1,000 edits; fixed ordinary-text inventory
slides.footer: Frequency above 0.01 nat is not gate firing. Severity is conditional on exceeding that threshold.
slides.notes: Same positions reused; window intervals do not cover subject or seed uncertainty.

slides.title: What does observed tail shape add?
slides.status: Exploratory finite-range fits; primary threshold 0.01 nat
slides.footer: Learned v5: little predictive gain over exponential. Stable v0: a more pronounced observed tail.
slides.notes: Conditional window intervals; illustrative r0/order100. No asymptotic class or infinite-variance finding.

slides.title: Two interventions against extreme prediction loss
slides.status: κ: development success rule missed. Mixture: ten exposed memories pass.
slides.footer: Mixture keeps retention within two points; CounterFact KL remains above 0.001.
slides.notes: κ pilot: bounded surprisal, not calibrated entropy. Mixture: analytic one-nat ceiling at shared prefix.

slides.title: Predictive coding: retention, harm and learning cost
slides.status: Depth controls: order100, three realizations per dataset; exposed historical streams.
slides.footer: Random: 3/993 immediate successes. Adjoint budget offered, underspent.
slides.notes: More own-prompt retention does not establish better generalization or equal-compute superiority.

slides.title: Does PC credit transfer to the fixed v5 reader?
slides.status: One exposed R1 realization per dataset; 300 edits; paired credit-rule intervention
slides.footer: Same BP base, trained reader, gates, memory capacity and stream; fresh memory for each arm.
slides.notes: Separate reader training: 10/12 evaluations; 2 paired seeds; ~100× BP cost. Third seed pending.

slides.title: What should the agent do next?
slides.status: Proposed active-inference extension; no new pre-October-9 commitment
slides.footer: Learning from observed failures motivates an experiment on autonomous information seeking.
slides.notes: Coupled free energy is a candidate objective. No implemented policy loop or blanket theorem.

slides.title: What we learned, what remains, what it took
slides.status: Measured credit and tail interventions; autonomous audit policies remain proposed.
slides.footer: 270-cell snapshot: 392.42 process-hours, not elapsed GPU hours. PC costs reported separately.
slides.notes: GPT-2 small (124M): transfer to production scale unestablished. Experiment cutoff Oct 9; talk Oct 15.
